gen-fs-segment-gf-lexend-mega: Wide gaps between neighboring letters and a tall, stocky middle band give Segment its systematic, commanding look, with Lexend Mega below. One-nib strokes and a gap in every c keep it approachable.
gen-fs-segment-gf-lexend-tera: Lexend Tera draws a single-weight line like a plotter pen, with stepping-stone gaps between letters. Lexend Tera beside Segment feels contemporary and systematic, with little pressure swell to slow the eye.
gen-fs-segment-gf-lexend-zetta: Approachable and widely tracked, with tall-bodied small letters, Lexend Zetta keeps every stroke ribbon-straight. Lexend Zetta does its best work staying constant and straight-edged, while Segment does its best with commanding, widely spaced letters.
gen-fs-segment-gf-montserrat-alternates: Segment spreads its letters wide and stands stocky, with open counters breathing into the white space. And Montserrat Alternates brings chalk-board lowercase crowding toward the capital line, its rims matching its stems.
gen-fs-sharpie-archivo: Sharpie leaves only a hairline crack between letters, like text pressed behind a narrow slot. Archivo, with curves opening outward and a commanding x-height, lets the lowercase loosen up where Sharpie stays closed.
gen-fs-sharpie-clash-grotesk: Sharpie is bold and expressive, its letters crowded behind a narrow slot. Clash Grotesk lines up beside it, plain sans with cut-out strokes like a router bit, clean, approachable, and not meant for extended paragraphs.
gen-fs-sharpie-fs-asap: Asap keeps its c as an open arc and its lowercase close to capital height, readable plain sans. Asap is best at staying open, while Sharpie is best at being bold, closed and tightly packed.
gen-fs-sharpie-fs-epilogue: Epilogue has curvy, unclamped letters on a wire-like monoline skeleton, with tall-bodied lowercase and stubby ascender tips. But Sharpie crowds its letters tight and bold, so Epilogue's loose curves feel freer beneath.
gen-fs-sharpie-fs-fira-sans: Sharpie packs its letters behind a narrow slot, hairline gaps and all. Fira Sans, with s curves opening wide at both ends and a larger-than-usual x-height, loosens what Sharpie crams tight.
gen-fs-sharpie-fs-merriweather-sans: Sturdy and large-looking, Merriweather Sans has tall lowercase, plus an e whose eye opens clearly to the right. Merriweather Sans lets Sharpie stay tight and closed while the page itself opens up.
